lantern_inn.title: The Lantern and Anchor
lantern_inn.description: Rain hammers the windows of the Lantern and Anchor. A low fire fights the sea damp, and the smell of chowder and wet wool fills the room.

reef_path.title: The Lantern Reef
reef_path.description: The reef path runs east between black rocks and grey water. A leaning warning post points toward the tide caves, and the sea never quite stops moving.

tide_cave.title: The Tide Caves
tide_cave.description: Cold water laps at the cave floor. Old ropes and broken crates mark the high-tide line, and something pale moves just beyond the lantern light.

bell_chamber.title: The Sunken Bell
bell_chamber.description: A drowned chapel opens around a massive bronze bell. The air tastes of salt and old iron, and the bell is humming even though it has not been struck.
